hooks.text: 网格中每块物品都会影响周围格子，形成因果联动构筑
hooks.excerpt: It’s a game of competitive inventory management, where every tile you place in your grid has a strategic cause-and-effect loop that impacts the tiles around it.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 异步对战匹配同进度玩家留下的构筑，离场后自己的构筑也进入数据库
hooks.excerpt: Whenever you start a battle you will go against a build from the same chamber, with the same number of shop rounds as you. Whenever you exit a battle, your build is added to the matchmaking database and someone else can face it. Whether you win the whole run or not has no influence on which builds are added to the matchmaking database. The builds you face as opponents may have lost the run or still be in the middle of it. You can face the build of someone who has played seconds before.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 通过唯一代码分享构筑，直接挑战朋友或社区精选阵容
hooks.excerpt: Duels let you challenge a specific build by entering a simple code. Share your own builds with a unique code, test yourself against a friend’s strategy or go up against selected Feature Builds from our community!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
